why: Found while building, before any measured run. Listed's dynamic storage array (uint256[]) also makes its typed model refuse it (holon.sorts.model3: an index into uint256[], only static arrays of words are compiled), so under I111's types fallback the document is opaque and no law is derived over it: P4's alone and constrained shapes, which read records over Listed, were vacuous (the test's assertTrue on the records failed). The array is now static (uint256[3], written at a parameter index under a range check): the typed model compiles it, so Listed is typed and has laws, and E2 over transitions documents still does not map its index path segment (the same refusal, 'a path segment [index, ...]'). The claims, the other contracts and every assertion are unchanged.

Found while building, before any measured run. P3 claims the set with no fallen-back document equals the set without the opt-in (once evidence_sha256 and the adoption sidecar's inputs entry are removed). The test compared I116's protocol with I112's, which differ in more than the opt-in: every sidecar the driver generates carries its protocol's iteration in its doc text, so the sorts assignment's input sha256 differed. The test now compares I116's protocol with I116's protocol without document_fallback (the opt-in alone), as the claim says. The claim and the assertion are unchanged.
